location_description: San Luis Obispo (; Spanish for "St. Louis the Bishop", Spanish: [san ˈlwis oˈβispo]) is a city and county seat of San Luis Obispo County, in the U.S. state of California. Located on the Central Coast of California, San Luis Obispo is roughly halfway between the San Francisco Bay Area in the north and Greater Los Angeles in the south.
